sections.title: Unit 4: The Art of Hungarian Public Debate
body: Hungarian political freedom was born not in silent consensus, but in fiery, disciplined parliamentary debates. The Reform Era and the Age of Dualism forged a culture of oratory where the spoken word could reshape laws, borders, and national identity.

In this unit, you will explore the giants of Hungarian debate: the historic clash between Count István Széchenyi and Lajos Kossuth, Ferenc Deák's legal precision, dualist parliamentary obstruction, legendary press polemics, and the evolution of public discourse in the digital era.
